# Config schema

Alpage config is HCL. The blocks below are the complete schema; it is generated from the `hcl:"..."` struct tags in `nns/`, so it always matches what the tool parses.

## `resources.hcl`

### `subnet "<name>" { }`

A subnet, referenced from proposals and nodes as subnet.<name>.id.

| Field | Kind | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | attr | yes | Principal of the subnet. |
| `label` | attr | no | Human-readable name. |
| `sev_enabled` | attr | no | Whether the subnet runs with SEV-SNP enabled, reconciled against the registry's features.sev_enabled. Omitted means false. |

### `data_center "<name>" { }`

A registry data center, referenced by node_operator as data_center.<name>.id.

| Field | Kind | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | attr | yes | Registry data center id. |
| `label` | attr | no | Human-readable name. |
| `region` | attr | no | Registry region string (e.g. Europe,CH,Vaud). |

### `node_provider "<name>" { }`

A node provider, referenced by node_operator as node_provider.<name>.id.

| Field | Kind | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | attr | yes | Principal of the node provider. |
| `label` | attr | no | Human-readable name. |

### `node_operator "<name>" { }`

A node operator, referenced by node as node_operator.<name>.id.

| Field | Kind | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | attr | yes | Principal of the node operator. |
| `label` | attr | no | Human-readable name. |
| `provider` | attr | no | Id of its node provider (node_provider.<name>.id). |
| `dc` | attr | no | Id of its data center (data_center.<name>.id). |

### `node "<name>" { }`

A node, referenced from proposals as node.<name>.id.

| Field | Kind | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | attr | yes | Principal of the node. |
| `label` | attr | no | Human-readable name. |
| `subnet` | attr | no | Id of the subnet it belongs to (subnet.<name>.id). Empty means unassigned. |
| `operator` | attr | no | Id of its node operator (node_operator.<name>.id). |
| `decommissioned` | attr | no | Marks a node deregistered on-chain. Its block is kept so historical proposal payloads keep resolving to the ids they were submitted with; reconcile expects it to be absent from the registry. |

## `proposals.hcl`

### `provider { }`

Global submission settings; CLI flags override these.

| Field | Kind | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `host` | attr | no | Governance host URL. Defaults per command; overridden by --host. |
| `neuron` | attr | no | Proposer neuron id. |
| `fetch_root_key` | attr | no | Whether to fetch the IC root key. Unset defaults to true for non-mainnet hosts. |

### `proposal "<name>" { }`

One NNS proposal. Carries common metadata plus a nested block named after its kind.

| Field | Kind | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `kind` | attr | yes | Proposal kind; selects the nested block (resize, deploy_guestos). |
| `title` | attr | yes | Proposal title shown on the NNS. |
| `summary` | attr | no | Proposal summary (markdown). |
| `url` | attr | no | Reference URL (e.g. forum thread). |

### `resize { }`

Nested in a proposal of kind "resize": change_subnet_membership. Holds add/remove node blocks.

| Field | Kind | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `subnet_id` | attr | yes | Subnet to resize (subnet.<name>.id). |
| `add` | block | no | A node to add to the subnet; repeatable. See the add / remove block. |
| `remove` | block | no | A node to remove from the subnet; repeatable. See the add / remove block. |

### `deploy_guestos { }`

Nested in a proposal of kind "deploy_guestos": deploy_guestos_to_all_subnet_nodes.

| Field | Kind | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `subnet_id` | attr | yes | Subnet whose nodes to upgrade (subnet.<name>.id). |
| `replica_version_id` | attr | yes | Replica version to deploy to every node in the subnet. |

### `add / remove { }`

Inside a resize block: a node to add to or remove from the subnet.

| Field | Kind | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | attr | yes | Node id (node.<name>.id). |
| `label` | attr | no | Optional human-readable name. |
